root_cause_static_analysis.summary: Under the frozen Stage-4D policy, 79 GT components (57 of them TINY) receive NO matched predicted proposal. The GT-assisted supply-only intervention (A-only) restores Tiny Recall to 1.0 (R_A=1.0), while the contamination-only intervention (C-only) leaves Tiny Recall unchanged (R_C=0.0). Therefore missing PROPOSAL SUPPLY is the causally NECESSARY and uniquely-selectable bottleneck for the regional Tiny-recall signal.
proposal_pipeline_trace: image -> KUBLocalizer(Phase-13B, heatmap_res 128) -> sigmoid prob map
extract_predicted_components: prob>=0.10, 8-connected label, sort by max_prob, keep top 100
root_cause_static_analysis.mechanism_of_loss: make_gaussian_heatmap applies a SINGLE FIXED sigma=0.75 to every component regardless of size. Tiny components therefore receive a diffuse, low-contrast positive target. The localizer (trained on many such peaks weighted toward larger components) learns to emit smoothed blobs; the tiny-component center peak is suppressed below the 0.10 decode threshold or merged into a neighboring larger peak, so no component and hence no proposal is emitted for it.
root_cause_static_analysis.evidence: 57/72 TINY and 79/152 total GT components are zero-proposal under frozen policy; supplying one GT-assisted ROI per zero-proposal component restores 100% of them (A-only recall_TINY=1.0, R_A=1.0).

intervention.definition: Make the localizer training target size-adaptive: replace the single fixed sigma=0.75 in make_gaussian_heatmap with a per-component sigma derived from the component's area in heatmap space (smaller sigma for tiny components -> sharper, higher-contrast peak; capped at the historical 0.75 for large components). Canonical center pixel stays 1.0; pixelwise-max fusion unchanged.
intervention.why_selected: It is the most directly-matched single-axis intervention to the identified mechanistic root cause (diffuse low-density tiny targets), it touches only the target-generation code (1 source file, backward-compatible), leaves architecture, loss, optimizer, proposal policy, refiner, and downstream eval completely frozen, and it is the minimal-blast-radius lever that can make the SAME localizer architecture supply tiny proposals without GT assistance.

rejected_options.reason_rejected: Reweights the loss toward tiny components but does not change the target geometry; it acts on the same diffuse targets and is less directly matched to the root cause. Rejected to keep a single clean axis (target support).
Changes localizer architecture/head, the largest blast radius of the three, and conflates an architecture change with the target-support hypothesis. Rejected to preserve single-axis isolation.

intervention.selection_rule: Pick the intervention that most directly targets the identified mechanistic root cause with the smallest blast radius (fewest frozen axes changed). Target-support redesign satisfies both: mechanism-matched (diffuse tiny targets -> sharper tiny targets) and minimal (1 module, backward-compatible default).

proposed_experiment.description: Retrain the Phase-13B localizer with IDENTICAL architecture, data, seed, optimizer, and proposal policy, changing ONLY the training-target support (size-adaptive sigma). Produces a new deployable localizer checkpoint.
proposed_experiment.changed_axis_only: localizer training target support (make_gaussian_heatmap size-adaptive sigma, opt-in flag size_adaptive_sigma=True in kub_localizer_dataset.py)
proposed_experiment.unchanged: architecture, loss, optimizer, scheduler, seed, data, proposal policy, refiner, downstream eval
proposed_experiment.expected_output: checkpoints/h3_kub_localizer_sigma_adaptive_sizeaware_seed42_clean_v3/best.pt (selected by supply-aware VAL rule, see checkpoint_selection_rule artifact)

primary_supply_criteria_prospective.note: Primary (supply) criteria are necessary but not sufficient; downstream R_H3 is the adjudication gate.

min_meaningful_improvement.note: R_H3>=0.30 means H3 closes at least 30% of the [Tg, 1.0] Tiny-recall gap left by the frozen PREDICTED system.

failure_boundary.label: H3_SUPPLY_REDESIGN_INSUFFICIENT
failure_boundary.consequence: Target-support redesign declared insufficient for the supply axis. H3 is NOT closed. Phase-15 remains NOT_STARTED_AND_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Reconsider Option B (positive-objective reweighting) or Option C (recall-oriented head) under fresh authorization; do NOT promote this checkpoint to downstream.

contamination_treatment.rationale: C-only did not move Tiny Recall (R_C=0.0), so contamination is not the recall bottleneck. FP burden / Dice are tracked for reporting but are NOT gates for H3 success or failure.
